coordinateConvention: Zero-based absolute source pixel centres, adaptive sourceRegion. Geometric door height is bottomY-topY; inclusive occupancy is separately reported. Physical ground centres derive from opposite ground-plane side vertices, not global alpha extent.

visibleOpening.note: Actual personnel door at the path endpoint and visible hardware. Automatic candidate at x243 is a raised facade window and is excluded. Both inner door endpoints visible; outer cream frame excluded. Separately observed pale outer-frame head and bright threshold endpoints are recorded at the same x; source cream/wall boundary has ±3px ambiguity. Frame endpoints exclude roof eaves and higher facade framing; no hidden endpoint inferred.

groundPlaneEstimate.method: Robust foreground alpha>128 bottom contour in both independent axes plus per-axis 95th-percentile positive post-foot residual. Source fence-ground plane, not silhouette-bottom anchor or raised rail. Corner positions are painted estimates with endpoint uncertainty.
